description: This Java source file defines a custom multipart encoder for Fineract Feign clients, utilizing Apache HttpClient's MultipartEntityBuilder to construct multipart/form-data requests.

classes.name: FineractMultipartEncoder
classes.description: A custom encoder for handling multipart/form-data requests in Fineract Feign clients, supporting file and text parts.

classes.name: FineractMultipartEncoder.MultipartData
classes.description: Represents multipart data composed of multiple parts, including files and text fields.

classes.name: FineractMultipartEncoder.MultipartData.Part
classes.description: A single part of multipart data, either a file or a text value.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes the given object into the request template, handling multipart data, files, and text content types.

methods.name: encodeFileAsMultipart
methods.description: Reads a file and encodes it as a multipart file part.

methods.name: detectContentType
methods.description: Detects the MIME content type of a file.

methods.name: encodeMultipart
methods.description: Builds and encodes multipart data into the request template.
